blurb: Clear Lake Marine Center is a family owned and operated full-service repair yard and marina since 1990. They offer over 160 slips including covered slings, covered water slips, and uncovered water slips. Facilities include a 75 BFMII Marine Travelift rated for 165,000 lbs, a 20-ton crane, and a covered repair building 67x70x39 ft tall.
extraNote: No sub-letting of slips or transfers without prior permission · No cooking grills on docks; must be used off dock in parking area · No fuel transfer or fueling in slips or at dock · No wake policy in effect at all times within marina · Boats must be seaworthy, clean, and properly tied; marina may tie boats and charge $50 service fee · Tenants responsible for damage caused by themselves or guests · Late fee $25 for payments after 10 days from due date · $75 fee if marina pumps your boat · $100 fee if boat is secured to slip for any reason
